hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Information about how NOVARI handles personal data when you visit our website or contact us.

controller.title: Controller responsible for data processing
controller.description: The party responsible for processing personal data on this website is:

general.title: General information
general.text1: We process personal data only where necessary to operate this website, respond to inquiries and provide our services.
general.text2: Personal data includes information that can identify you directly or indirectly, such as your name, email address, telephone number, IP address or information submitted through our forms.

hosting.title: Website hosting and server log files
hosting.text1: When you visit this website, the hosting provider may automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, date and time of access and requested pages.
hosting.text2: This information is generally processed to ensure the secure and reliable operation of the website.
hosting.notice: The final hosting provider and its privacy information will be added here once the website hosting is finalized.

contact.title: Contact by email or telephone
contact.text1: If you contact NOVARI by email or telephone, we process the information you provide in order to answer your inquiry and provide the requested service.
contact.text2: Your information is retained only for as long as necessary for the inquiry and any applicable legal retention obligations.

forms.title: Contact and quote forms
forms.text1: When you submit a contact or quotation request, we may process your name, email address, telephone number, service requirements, pickup and destination information and any additional information you provide.
forms.text2: The information is used to process your request, communicate with you and prepare a quotation.
forms.text3: Once the backend functionality is activated, this section will also identify the technical service providers involved in transmitting and storing form submissions.

uploads.title: Uploaded photos and videos
uploads.text: If you upload photos or videos with a quotation request, these files are processed only to assess the requested transport, moving, assembly, clearance or related service. Please avoid uploading unnecessary personal or sensitive information.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Our website contains links that allow you to contact NOVARI through WhatsApp. When you follow such a link, you leave our website and the privacy rules of WhatsApp and its provider apply.

maps.title: Maps and OpenStreetMap
maps.text: Where interactive maps or map tiles are loaded from external providers such as OpenStreetMap, technical information including your IP address may be transmitted to the relevant provider in order to display the map.

fonts.title: Web fonts
fonts.text: The website currently uses Archivo and Hanken Grotesk. If these fonts are loaded from an external provider such as Google Fonts, a connection to that provider may be established. For production use, locally hosted font files are preferable where practical.

storage.title: Local storage and language preference
storage.text: The website may store your selected language in your browser's local storage so that your preferred language can be restored during later visits. This information is stored locally in your browser.

rights.title: Your data protection rights
rights.intro: Subject to the applicable legal requirements, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
rights.access: Right of access to your stored personal data.
rights.erasure: Right to request deletion of personal data.
rights.restriction: Right to request restriction of processing.
rights.portability: Right to data portability where applicable.
rights.objection: Right to object to certain processing.
rights.withdrawal: Right to withdraw consent with effect for the future.

complaint.title: Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.text: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates applicable data protection law.

changes.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy when the website, services or legal requirements change.

aside.title: Questions about your data?
aside.description: Contact NOVARI if you have questions about the processing of your personal information.
